# Coastal Funding DSCR Blog

> DSCR (debt service coverage ratio) loan guides for real estate investors: how DSCR is calculated, qualifying on rental income instead of personal income, and financing investment properties.

This blog is published by Coastal Funding Corporation, a mortgage broker. It covers DSCR investment-property loans only. Articles are informational and are not a commitment to lend; rates and programs are subject to change.
